selection: All six videos and three registered seeds are fixed before labels or official metrics are opened; no threshold, seed, video, history mode or outer metric is selected.
hypothesis: A fixed visibility-weighted four-strip FIFO descriptor may preserve identity detail that the fitted global embedding removes; first measure same-graph correction/harm and fixed-margin complementarity before any combination replay.
predeclared_margin_gate: On each clean row with at least two locally available legal edges, use the local4 cue only when its top-two appearance-cost margin is strictly greater than the fitted-embedding margin; otherwise retain fitted embedding. No learned or fitted threshold.
promotion_gate: A combination replay is permitted only if local4 corrections exceed harms against embedding on every registered video and the fixed margin gate has positive correction-minus-harm on every registered video; otherwise record a diagnostic negative boundary and run no combination.
scope: Read-only same-input candidate-edge complementarity audit. The online tracker remains the fitted-embedding FIFO route and must be byte-identical to its accepted global-bank predictions. Prediction hashes are locked for all 18 runs before physical labels are opened. No GT, physical identity, future frame, teacher, external payload or cached inference feature enters online replay; labels are retrospective reducer inputs only.

guards.raw_fps: not measured; native association audit only
